_about: The iPhone's own words, English and Spanish side by side (Plan I7 call 1). tools/ios/make_text_ids.py puts them into Localizable.xcstrings beside the words that come from Android's strings.xml. A key is the English as the Swift compiler lists it (%@ for a String, %lld or %d for a count). A value is the Spanish, in the same neutral Latin American Spanish as Android's values-es (tú, Guardar for Keep, Solo local, paquetes); an object gives plural forms; "@android_key" takes Android's Spanish for that key where Android has the English under two keys with different Spanish; null means the same in every language (names, addresses, debug-only words). infoPlist holds Info.plist's words for InfoPlist.xcstrings.
